title: Graph-Transformer Fraud Detection with Self-Supervised Pretraining and Conformal Risk Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.14234v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Financial fraud in corporate transaction networks has grown more coordinated and harder to detect with rule-based engines and with classical learning models that treat each transaction in isolation. This paper presents GTFD, a graph-transformer fraud detector that fuses structural and temporal evidence from a corporation's payment graph. GTFD encodes the graph with a multi-head graph attention network, encodes ordered transaction sequences with a gated transformer, and combines both views through a cross-modal gating layer. A conformal risk-control head converts the fused representation into threshold-free anomaly scores with finite-sample coverage guarantees, and the network is trained with self-supervised link-mask pretraining plus adversarial augmentation so it remains stable under scarce labels and under adversarial perturbation. On a corporate transaction benchmark enriched with coordinated fraud rings, GTFD reaches an AUROC of 0.

translated_title: 基于自监督预训练与保形风险控制的图-Transformer欺诈检测
translated_abstract: 企业交易网络中的金融欺诈变得愈发有组织性，使用基于规则的引擎以及将每笔交易孤立处理的传统学习模型越来越难以检测。本文提出了GTFD，一种图-Transformer欺诈检测器，它融合了企业支付图中的结构性与时序性证据。GTFD使用多头图注意力网络对图进行编码，使用门控Transformer对有序交易序列进行编码，并通过跨模态门控层将两种视图结合起来。保形风险控制头将融合后的表示转换为无阈值异常评分，并提供有限样本覆盖保证；该网络通过自监督链路掩码预训练结合对抗性增强进行训练，因此能够在标签稀缺和对抗性扰动下保持稳定。在一个加入协同欺诈团伙的企业交易基准数据集上，GTFD的AUROC达到0.
tldr: 本文提出GTFD图-Transformer欺诈检测器，融合企业支付图的结构与时序信息，借助自监督链路掩码预训练、对抗增强和保形风险控制，在标签稀缺和对抗扰动下实现具有统计覆盖保证的稳健欺诈检测。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GTFD, a graph-transformer fraud detector that fuses structural and temporal evidence from corporate payment graphs, leveraging self-supervised link-mask pretraining, adversarial augmentation, and conformal risk control to achieve robust fraud detection with finite-sample coverage guarantees under label scarcity and adversarial perturbations.
